title: ClickUp pricing - Free through $19/user/month Business Plus, AI add-on stacks on top
clean_text: ClickUp's 2026 tiers (annual billing) are Free Forever ($0), Unlimited at $7/user/month, Business at $12/user/month, and Business Plus at $19/user/month, with Enterprise at custom pricing. Monthly (non-annual) billing raises Unlimited to $10 and Business to $19 per user/month -- among the steepest annual-vs-monthly discounts in the category (30-37%). ClickUp Brain, the AI add-on, costs an additional $9/user/month on top of any plan, so a team wanting AI on the Unlimited plan effectively pays $16/user/month rather than the $7 headline rate. Teams of 25-100 users commonly negotiate Enterprise rates of $5-$6.50/user/month on annual or multi-year terms.
